text:
emma (partnerships): Kicking off coordination with LockForge (HSM vendor) + two SI partners for the marketplace listing + joint press/tech announcement. Goal: SSO (SAML), SCIM user provisioning, and KMS/HSM key-wrapping integration validated before go-live.

ajay (security): Important: LockForge requires FIPS 140-2 certificate chain and offline key import for wrapped keys. We need to confirm our key-wrapping flow and KMS API compatibility.

sophie (eng-ml): Can we get a dev HSM endpoint? We need to run latency + failover tests against the wrapped-key path. Also SCIM user sync load profile (10k users/day) to size throttles.

liam (infra): I'll request a partner test account and a VPC peering setup. ETA 3 business days for networking; need contact from LockForge ops to share IPs and firewall rules. @andre can you share ops contact?

andre (vendor-sec): @liam yes — sending contacts in DM. Note: our test HSM currently enforces SAML IdP metadata signed assertions and <AuthnContext> checks. We'll post metadata and a short checklist.

emma (partnerships): High-level timeline proposal: week 0 (this week) — metadata & SCIM schema exchange; week 1 — private integration tests; week 2 — SI runbook dry-run; week 3 — joint announcement freeze and legal sign-off. Any blockers?

ajay (security): Blocker: we need legal to confirm embargo window + joint PR wording for security claims. Also require a brief threat model review for the key-wrapping flow. I'll tag legal/security-comms.

sophie (eng-ml): For SCIM, LockForge uses core/v2 with groups. We have a custom attribute mapping for roles -> inference-roles. Example mapping snippet they asked for:

```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "replace", "path": "members", "value": [{"value": "user-123", "display": "alice"}]}
  ]
}
```

liam (infra): That looks fine. We'll ensure our SCIM proxy exposes /v2/Users and /v2/Groups and rate-limits at 200 reqs/min. Sophie — can you confirm if that's acceptable for the SI partners?

sophie (eng-ml): 200 reqs/min should be OK for initial pilot; SI1 will batch changes overnight. SI2 prefers near-real-time, will need burst capacity — we'll add a quota override for them during testing.

emma (partnerships): Action items: 1) @andre share SAML metadata + HSM ops contact (by EOD) 2) @liam open partner VPC peering and SCIM endpoints (2 days) 3) @ajay threat model + legal/PR locks (this week) 4) @sophie test spec and load profile (end of week). I'll compile a shared checklist doc after this thread. :memo:

andre (vendor-sec): SAML metadata posted to partner portal: https://partners.lockforge.example/meta.xml — note they require signed metadata and SP-initiated flows only. Also, HSM test endpoint: hsm-test.lockforge.example:8443 (cert pinned).

deploy-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing draft needs final assets 5 days before public launch.

ajay (security): One more note: For KMS integration, LockForge supports AES-GCM wrapped keys and RSA-OAEP for import. We need to ensure our key lifecycle (rotate/wrap/unwrap) calls are logged to audit-log service with key-id hashing. Can we add audit hooks?

liam (infra): Yes — we'll add audit-log events for wrap/unwrap and include key hash. Sophie, does your test harness consume those events?

sophie (eng-ml): We'll add assertions for audit events in integration tests. Also building a perf test that simulates key unwrap under 10k token-per-second generation to measure latencies.

emma (partnerships): Great. If no objections, I'll set the weekly sync for Tuesdays 10am PT and create the checklist doc + invite SI leads. Thanks all — I'll post the checklist once I have the metadata + contacts. :handshake:
